name: Rishane Dassanayake
headline: Business Operations Associate at Longview Philanthropy
bio: Rishane Dassanayake is Business Operations Associate at Longview Philanthropy, where the organisation states he supports Longview's business operations. Before joining Longview he was an Economics Research Assistant working on AI and behavioural economics research. He led the LSE Effective Altruism society as an Open Philanthropy University Organizer Fellow and a Community Building Grantee for the Centre for Effective Altruism, and conducted AI safety research as part of the Cambridge AI Safety Hub's MARS programme. He holds a BSc in politics, philosophy and economics from the London School of Economics and Political Science.
